name: Flock Of Feather Fiends
description: A flock of undead crow corpses, eyes aglow with necroplasmic light.

abilities.name: Horde (1d6+1)
abilities.description: When the Flock has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 1d6+1 magic damage instead.

abilities.name: Maddening Cacophony
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Very Close range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must spend a Hope or become Vulnerable until they deal damage to the Flock or the Flock is defeated.
